instructions.name: approve
docs: Turns a verified signature into an approval of its action and burns the key.

instructions.name: discard_approval
docs: Closes an approval that never reached its threshold, after 7 days.

instructions.name: escape_sol
docs: Moves all of a wallet's SOL into its linked vault. Signed by the wallet, usually in a
pre-signed durable-nonce transaction stored in the link (docs/SPEC.md §7).

instructions.name: escape_token
docs: Moves a delegated token account of a linked wallet into its vault. Permissionless once
the canary has tripped or the wallet pressed panic.

instructions.name: execute_admin
docs: Cancel, Ping, CancelSchedule, CancelBudget and Migrate.

instructions.name: execute_pending
docs: Pays the pending SOL withdrawal, or starts the pending migration, once due.

instructions.name: execute_stake_authority
docs: Unstake and CollectStake.

instructions.name: raise_baseline
docs: Records a higher bounty as the new baseline (anyone may top the canary up).

instructions.name: spend_budget
docs: An ordinary session key spends from its budget (docs/SPEC.md §4).

instructions.name: testament_sol
docs: Splits all SOL among the heirs; heirs are the remaining accounts, in config order.

instructions.name: testament_token
docs: Splits all of one token among the heirs; remaining accounts are the heirs' token
accounts for this mint, in config order (create them first).

instructions.name: trip_canary
docs: Trips the canary if its bounty moved: only possible if ed25519 is broken.

instructions.name: verify
docs: Walks chains `from..to` to their ends. Freezes the buffer on first use. Permissionless.

accounts.name: vault
docs: signature bytes shows up in the vault's history (docs/SPEC.md §9).

types.name: Action
docs: What one approval authorizes. Signed as borsh bytes (docs/SPEC.md §4).

types.name: Approval
docs: Approvals collected for one action (docs/SPEC.md §4).

fields.name: trees
docs: Bit t set once tree t approved.

types.name: Config
docs: The rules of a vault. Its hash is part of the vault address, so it can never change.

types.name: Link
docs: An ordinary wallet's link to its vault: registry entry and Escape Hatch (docs/SPEC.md §7).

types.name: Unlock
docs: A signed action being assembled and verified over several transactions.
Zero-copy: the signature and chain ends are too big for the BPF stack.
